steps.content:
XX/XX
The day of the heist
Somewhere in Syndicate

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, this is Cross Street downtown Syndicate, where Golan was last seen according to the investigation team's arrest report. Cross Street is a lawless zone, teeming with members of big and small gangs coming here to exchange information. A comprehensive search will be extremely difficult here.
With a gang riot imminent, there are only two possible reasons Golan would risk returning to Syndicate...
Either the Mania weapons truly exist and Golan has come back to help the Iron Gang win during the heist, or she's here to deal with that weapon for the Iron Gang.
Her disappearance here suggests that a safe passage to the Iron Gang is nearby. Finding her is the only clue to pinpointing the battlefield.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Meanwhile, the Public Security Bureau has just informed you that a gang brawl has erupted around Margaret Street. It's only one intersection away from your current location, but it's still uncertain whether it's related to the Mania weapons.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Given the precarious situation in Syndicate, please prioritize your safety and retreat ASAP once you find any clues about Sinner Golan.
The street is growing noisier when a large flag sweeps before your eyes. You instinctively duck behind the street, only then registering Nightingale's last instruction.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Okay...
Before you finish, you feel a familiar pull in the palm of your hand. It's Golan.
You take a step back, and the sensation of the shackles grows stronger.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Found you.
Ending the call, you bypass the main street, follow the fluctuating signs of the shackles, and run through the meandering alleys toward the summons.
Finally, the sensation of the shackles peaks in an abandoned alley reeking of fish. You've just stepped into the alleyway when you hear Golan's trembling voice.
Golan seems to be arguing with the woman in front of her. You tread lightly, trying to listen in on their conversation.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: Cub let you in, didn't he? I hope he'll enjoy collecting debts on the outskirts for the next three months. We're about to go to war and he dared let in a deserter who betrayed us in black and white. How can we trust someone who treats his job like a joke?

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Miss Brenna... No, Mom! Listen to me! It's not Cub's fault. I forced him to tell me where you were.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: Blinded by sentiment even during a crisis. Sounds like someone you trained, indeed. Do you know all the gangs have their eyes on the Iron Gang now?

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: It's my responsibility to the Iron Gang to forbid any cowardly deserter to sneak back in during this critical moment.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I was wrong... Mom, knowing you, I know you'll never forgive me. Punish me however you want, but can we at least wait till I finish fighting this battle...

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Those riffraff have banded together because they think they can finally trample over us this time. I can't just stand by and watch their arrogance without doing anything!

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I've grown a lot these past few months. I've learned how to use my abilities proficiently at the Bureau! I'm sure this time I can help everyone out, I swear!
You've never seen Golan act like this before. Both her bold behavior at the Bureau and the outrageous deeds documented in her file suggest she's not the demure lady she usually pretends to be.
But even under her obedient disguise at the Bureau, she rarely puts herself in the role of a subordinate.
Now, despite Golan's high volume, she's not the one in control of this conversation.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: No one cares if you stay or leave. The Iron Gang's victory never depends on one single person.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Please, Mom, can you just stop being mad at me for a second... You really can't do it without me this time. They're going all in with their firepower for this battle!

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: Mad at you? Can't do it without you? Golan, all this time, you've never learned to read the situation.
The woman scoffs, her laugh not reaching her eyes.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: Sometimes I really wonder where your education went wrong. How did I raise such a naive fool like you?

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: The lookouts from all the other gangs out there are watching you. They didn't believe your desertion before, and they won't believe you're dead now.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: Their plan is to have all their men launch a massive attack on us the second they get wind that you get in touch with the Iron Gang.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: Everyone in the Iron Gang has been denying any connection with you and planning to grit their teeth and weather the attack today. When the enemies arrive and find out you're indeed gone, that will be the end of it.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: And here you've swaggered back without even the slightest awareness of your circumstances... How am I supposed to explain to everyone that you want to fight alongside them now?
You faintly feel the woman glance at you as she talks, but it's so subtle you're not sure if she's really spotted you.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I don't want to wait for them to change their mind after they attack us. I don't want them to realize Golan is indeed gone amid the dead bodies of our people.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: And if they find out we don't have any Sinners or Mania weapons anymore, then we'll turn into helpless prey! They won't let the Iron Gang live.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: Whether we live or die, that's the Iron Gang's fate. It has nothing to do with you.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: You can't sacrifice so much for me... It's not fair to you.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I... I'll explain to everyone myself. I'm confident as long as I can lead everyone through this battle, they'll remain loyal.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: Did you see Sunny and Joy on your way here? They must be with Cub. Did you see their wounds?

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: The Deluge guys cornered them in a stinking alley and beat them up to get your whereabouts. Sunny didn't talk even though they got her on her knees. Joy fought back, and they shoved his head to the ground and fed him dirt.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: They are loyal. If you show up, those idiots will definitely follow your orders. One word from you and they're ready to fight.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: But what about you? Can you still stand their loyalty?

Despite Brenna's sharp words, you can tell every member of the Iron Gang is willing to sacrifice themselves for Golan's safety. This much is consensus among them. But Golan can't accept this arrangement.
Golan looks like a child who has done something wrong, unable to defend herself. Even when she tries to emphasize how she can be of help, the confidence in her voice shrinks.
She still insists on staying, yet she doesn't know how else to convince the woman in front of her.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Once this is over, I'll accept any punishment for the responsibilities I'd shirked before according to our rules, and I'll...

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: [Scene Transition - Clementine's Study]
The woman interrupts Golan before she can finish.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: Your whereabouts have been exposed for quite some time now. I don't know how many people have discovered where you are, but everyone must be poised for action now.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: Go. The Iron Gang has nothing to do with you anymore.
She glances in your direction, and this time you can clearly feel her gaze landing on you.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: Even if you're not being tracked, that friend of yours probably is. They won't let any unfamiliar face go at this time.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: Let alone a cop this conspicuous.
It's only then that Golan notices your presence. She turns to look at you, a mix of despair and annoyance flooding her face.
She stares at her mother's back turned resolutely to her, all the questions she was suppressing and too afraid to ask now washing over her.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I don't understand...

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: If you wanted me to become a worthy and responsible heiress to the gang, why didn't you tell me the truth about our family's business from the start...
Brenna turns her back. You can't see the expression on her face. She simply sighs almost inaudibly.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: I had no choice.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: I've spent my whole life in the Iron Gang. I'm used to fighting and killing. You're different. I wanted you to have a choice.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: Since you chose them when the choices were presented to you, you have nothing to do with Syndicate or the gangs anymore.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: Get lost, you shouldn't have come here. Don't give us extra trouble for getting that cop hurt when the fight starts.
With that last sentence, Brenna ignores Golan and leaves.
Watching her mother's dwindling figure, Golan stands there somewhat helplessly.
Golan's mother was right. Someone might have discovered Golan's whereabouts. You hear a restless buzz in the distance. Shouts and gunshots.
The noise of the brawl grows near. Communication with Nightingale finally becomes smooth.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, how's it going? The gang fight has started to spread in your direction. For your safety, please move to the suggested location and meet up with us.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Alright, I'll be there soon.
You want to take Golan and leave this place quickly, but she stands rooted to the spot, still looking in the direction her mother has gone in.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You can process all that later. We need to leave at once. We're not far from your base, right? If someone finds us, it'll only put your mother and friends in an even worse position.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: ...Let's go. I'll cover you. Stay behind me and be careful.
Golan goes ahead with her head down. But luck's not on your side. Just as you reach the end of the alley, you run into two patrolling thugs.

steps.speaker: Thug A
steps.content: Holy ****! Isn't this our Miss Golan? You really are alive!!!

steps.speaker: Thug A
steps.content: People have been going crazy looking for you out there, and here you are, hiding in plain sight?!

steps.speaker: Thug B
steps.content: I just knew she couldn't be dead! I mean, what a loss will that be? We can take her back alive to the boss! We hit the jackpot, didn't we? Haha!

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: You better piss off now and keep your mouth shut out there, or I'll rip your jaw off.
Facing the menacing thugs, Golan quickly steps in front of you. She doesn't initiate an attack but tries to shake them off and keep moving.
A stained baseball bat pokes her on the shoulder.

steps.speaker: Thug A
steps.content: Tsk tsk, quit acting all high and mighty now. Do you think you're still in the ******* Iron Gang after you faked your death and ran away? You should see how miserable you are...

steps.speaker: Thug B
steps.content: Instead of being a street rat, why don't you surrender and join us? How about it?

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: **** off! You're lucky I've never beaten you up before, but don't push it. Join you? And become lowlifes like you?
Enraged, the thug picks up the baseball bat and swings it at you. Golan pushes you away and meets the attack with her parasol.
The thug who got hit picks up a brick from the ground indignantly and tries to throw it. You see it and rush over to shoulder the assailant off.
Golan immediately turns around to elbow the attacker.
Beaten up defenselessly, the thugs fall unconscious. But it seems that Golan hasn't recovered from the rush of emotions just yet.
Now you finally understand. Golan is the dead heiress to the Iron Gang. No one else should know about her appearance in Syndicate. So you tie up the unconscious thugs to prevent them from escaping.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Even these thugs almost got the better of me. My mom was right. I'm too weak.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You don't get stronger overnight. Give yourself more time and patience.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: No need to comfort me. It's a good thing... to get a proper understanding of myself now.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Why did they say taking you back would earn them a reward? And that people are looking for you? Does it have anything to do with that ready-made weapon you mentioned before? Did you hide it?

The mysterious weapon, the subtle animosity between the Iron Gang and the other gangs, the heist... These things all seem to be connected by a thin thread, but the piece joining them together is still missing.
But if Golan was related to that weapon, the Iron Gang wouldn't have let her go so easily.
Perhaps because you've already seen her at a vulnerable moment, or perhaps to repay your help just now, she finally speaks after a long silence.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I've never touched any ready-made weapon. I didn't even know what a Mania weapon was six months ago.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: You might not believe it, but I've never been involved in any dirty work, stuff like dealing Mania weapons, shootouts, smuggling... because my mom wouldn't allow it.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Since I was little, she's always kept me away from the gangs. She taught me combat skills for self-defense and only sent me to collect debts and put on a show with a bunch of underlings. She never let me near the real dirty work that got one's hands dirty.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Even if she accidentally slipped up in front of me, she refused to let me help. She even specifically created the harshest punishment within our gang regarding this.
Thud... Thud... Thud...

steps.speaker: Cub
steps.content: Boss lady... Boss... lady... Go get help, quickly... Bring more people... to save the boss.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Cub? What happened? My mom... You guys... Weren't you guys supposed to be picking up the shipment?

steps.speaker: Cub
steps.content: Hurry... Or it'll be too late...

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: It was only then I realized my mom took out the most powerful firearm from the safe to prepare for the biggest gang fight in years.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: It was also the first time I realized that for an infamous Syndican gang to survive, you must take what belonged to others, and in the most violent way. You must become the biggest winner on the battlefield. Otherwise, those who failed to take anything would take advantage of the situation and prey on you.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: By the time I arrived with reinforcements, our people were all injured or maimed, struggling to swat off thugs from all sorts of small gangs.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Mom! What happened to you? What happened here?

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: Golan? What are you doing here? It's too dangerous. Go back!

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: At that time, all I saw was the wreckage of the battlefield. My once formidable mother was covered in wounds, still fighting while protecting a dying subordinate. Everyone else had gone down, leaving her alone to still protect those behind her desperately.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: The battlefield was covered in unconscious bodies and blood. At that time, I had no idea what I was supposed to do, dazed as if I was sleepwalking.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: But when I saw a thug pull out a Mania weapon and point it at my mom, my brain and body went completely out of control. An inexplicable rage exploded in me. I had never felt so angry in my life. I rushed over to protect her.

steps.speaker: Enemy Thug
steps.content: Caught off guard, weren't you? Hahaha, today is the day I'll take the life of this monster of a woman!

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Mom! Watch out!

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Maybe because I was too eager to protect my family, or because I was screaming no inside my head. For whatever reason, in that moment, it felt like some kind of power surged within me.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You mean, after you took that hit from the Mania weapon for your mother on the battlefield, you awakened?

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Exactly. During that most severe gang fight, witnessed by everyone, I awakened as a Sinner.
It suddenly clicked why those thugs looked as if they had struck gold when they found Golan. And you finally grasped the true meaning of the so-called heist.
The mass destruction Mania weapon they're fighting for is Golan.
That better weapon Golan was hinting at was in fact herself.
In Syndicate, even a stray dog knows a Sinner is worth ten Mania weapons. If trained properly, a Sinner makes the best Mania weapon.
This explains why all the gangs are striving to come up with all sorts of plans and why they've become exceptionally active after discovering Golan's whereabouts.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But isn't it more dangerous to wander alone in Syndicate? Why not stay with the Iron Gang? At least you wouldn't have to face any threats alone.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Chief, this is not how you survive in Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: A living Sinner from a gang is much rarer than any resource or weapon. That's why from that day on, I became a moving target in the gang brawls who everyone wanted to test their strength with. The Iron Gang has never seen a peaceful day since.

steps.speaker: Cub
steps.content: Boss lady, this way! Please take a break here. I'll go and chase those guys away!

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: ...Don't go, Cub. We're better off hiding here. They'll give up sooner or later.

steps.speaker: Cub
steps.content: No way! They all think they're good enough to try us now. If we don't teach them a lesson, they won't stop pestering you!

steps.speaker: Cub
steps.content: Don't worry. You stay here. I'll handle it quickly.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: At that time, every day was a struggle.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: On one hand, I thought about how to use this new power to eliminate all of the Iron Gang's enemies. On the other hand, I was afraid. I feared that all the people I cared about would falter on the battlefield, that to protect one meant to sacrifice another...

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I tried to become a proper heiress, but I failed. I neither had the resolve to kill nor was smart enough to solve problems otherwise.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: In the end, all I brought to the family was trouble, and I made the Iron Gang an easy target for other gangs.

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: Gradually, I began to want to escape... but every time I thought about running away, I felt extremely guilty. I even began to think if I hadn't taken that hit for Mom, I wouldn't have been in so much pain.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: But when I snapped out of it, I felt like the most unforgivable scumbag in the world for having that thought.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Gaining such a formidable power should be a good thing. But why did it make me so sad...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That's why you moved into a rented home and tried to live like an ordinary person. That was the best solution you could think of to free you all.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Yes... I thought this would protect them, but I was too naive. I didn't know that those people wouldn't believe I had fled and would even use it as an excuse to provoke the Iron Gang.
Golan stops in her tracks, looking back. The small courtyard where she talked with Brenna is no longer visible, but she's still staring intently.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: But I dare not go home, because I haven't gotten any stronger. In fact, no one expects anything of me. As long as I return, everyone will still do their best to protect me, just like what you heard a moment ago.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: But... but every time I see the suppressed exhaustion in my mom, and the increasing injuries on Cub, Joy, and Sunny, I just can't face it...

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Chief, am I in so much pain because I'm too weak?
Having spilled the deepest secret in her heart, Golan doesn't feel relieved. Instead, she feels overwhelmingly powerless.
This is the destination she wishes to reach, the home she wants to guard but finds no way to.
She may not have intended to confide in you, but the confession itself no doubt requires a great deal of trust. You want to do something in return for this precious trust.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If you no longer want to face this, the MBCC can take care of it. Solving the Mania weapon riot and retrieving Sinner Golan are two separate tasks. I can have someone take you back to the Bureau first, and then the MBCC will handle this gang fight.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If you want, this doesn't have to be your responsibility. Let it become the MBCC's job.
Your earnestness pays off. Golan's expression finally lightens a little.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Thank you, Chief. But no need.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I started this conflict, so I should also be the one to end it. I don't want so many people to die for me. I must repay my debt. I must help them.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Otherwise, even if I return to the MBCC, I will never find closure.
At last, guilt and indebtedness push her toward her lonely fight. This deepens your worry for her.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Then...
Boom!
A shoddy incendiary bomb blows off the low wall and instantly plunges the entire block into a sea of flames.
Golan watches it happen with a frown.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief! The situation has changed. The fight has escalated. Please retreat ASAP! Our team is breaking through the perimeter. A vehicle is waiting at the meeting point to pick up you and Golan.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Copy. Golan?
No response.
You turn around to see no one, only a slender figure advancing through the flames, eventually disappearing in the direction where the fight sounds the most chaotic.
